title: Cutie patooties
text: Cutie patooties. These are so darn cute and look just like my two chihuahuas. The only gripe was that when I took them out of the box the magnet on the girl pup pulled the magnet out of the boy pup.  No biggie I guess I just super glued it back in.

product_metadata.title: Westland Giftware Chihuahua Sweaters Salt and Pepper Shakers
description: These adorable "Mwah." salt and pepper shakers feature two sweatered chihuahuah's, and are even magnetic so that they appear to be kissing. These are a great addition to any table. Westland Giftware is known for quality and design.
